title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Reading On-Chain and Market Signals Together

questions.text: Which combination of signals helps traders avoid fake breakouts according to lesson 1?
options: Price action, volume, funding rates, and on-chain wallet activity
questions.explanation: Using all four signals together avoids fake breakouts and high-leverage traps.

questions.text: True or false: When large amounts of crypto move from centralized exchanges to private cold wallets, it indicates major holders are accumulating for the long term.
questions.explanation: Moving funds off exchanges suggests long-term accumulation by major holders.
